event.name: Sammakka-Saralamma Jatara, Medaram
event.description: Biennial tribal congregation at the Medaram gaddes and the Jampanna Vagu bathing ghats, held over four days. Asia’s largest tribal gathering: cumulative footfall exceeds one crore pilgrims.

syndromes.name: Acute Haemorrhagic Fever Syndrome
syndromes.caseDefinition: Acute onset of fever of less than 3 weeks duration with any haemorrhagic manifestation (bleeding gums, petechiae, purpura).
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Envenomation / Animal Bite
syndromes.caseDefinition: Any history of snake bite, scorpion sting or bite by a rabid or unknown animal. Requires anti-venom / anti-rabies pathway.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Acute Diarrhoeal Disease
syndromes.caseDefinition: Three or more loose or watery stools in the last 24 hours, with or without dehydration. Cluster of cases suggests a common source.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Acute Jaundice Syndrome
syndromes.caseDefinition: Acute onset of jaundice (yellow discolouration of sclera/skin) with or without fever. Screen for viral hepatitis A/E in a gathering.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Fever with Rash
syndromes.caseDefinition: Fever with maculopapular rash — consider measles, rubella, dengue, chikungunya or a scrub typhus eschar.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Severe Acute Respiratory Infection
syndromes.caseDefinition: Fever and cough with shortness of breath, of onset within the last 10 days. Isolate and refer.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Influenza-like Illness
syndromes.caseDefinition: Fever of 100 °F or more with cough, of onset within the last 10 days, without shortness of breath.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Fever with Arthralgia
syndromes.caseDefinition: Acute fever with joint pain — consider chikungunya or dengue in a vector-prone gathering site.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Fever of more than 7 days
syndromes.caseDefinition: Fever persisting beyond 7 days — investigate for enteric fever, malaria, scrub typhus or tuberculosis.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Injury / Trauma
syndromes.caseDefinition: Any abrasion, laceration or fracture sustained at or en route to the gathering. Stampede and crowd-crush surveillance signal.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Media Scanning & Outbreak Alert Guidelines — NCDC

syndromes.name: Heat-related Illness
syndromes.caseDefinition: Dehydration or giddiness with a high ambient temperature exposure — common in open-air gatherings and processions.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Media Scanning & Outbreak Alert Guidelines — NCDC

syndromes.name: Acute Febrile Illness
syndromes.caseDefinition: Fever of less than 7 days duration without localising signs. Baseline syndrome for undifferentiated fever.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

syndromes.name: Acute Respiratory Infection
syndromes.caseDefinition: Cough or shortness of breath without documented fever.
syndromes.reference: IDSP Syndromic Surveillance, P-Form — NCDC, Government of India

roles.name: State Super User
roles.description: Full platform administrator. Configures roles, users, masters, address hierarchy and facilities; sees every district and camp.

roles.name: State Level Officer
roles.description: State-wide operational oversight. Runs events and camps, acknowledges alerts, cannot alter roles or platform masters.

roles.name: Regional Level User
roles.description: Oversees a group of districts. Coordinates camps and referrals across the region.

roles.name: Department Head
roles.description: Heads a line department (Health, Revenue, Police, Fire, Sanitation). Full visibility of the department across the state.

roles.name: Department Domain User
roles.description: Subject-matter user inside a department (e.g. IDSP surveillance, drug logistics, ambulance control).

roles.name: District Level User
roles.description: District administrator for the gathering. Owns camps, rosters and stock within the district.

roles.name: District Domain User
roles.description: District subject-matter user — e.g. DSU-IDSP, district drug store, district lab coordinator.

roles.name: Supervisory Staff
roles.description: Supervises a set of camps on the ground. Lowest level with live dashboard access, marks attendance and camp readiness.

roles.name: Field Staff
roles.description: Paramedic / staff nurse / medical officer at the camp. Records vitals and the clinical section of the walk-in form.

roles.name: Volunteer
roles.description: Registers walk-ins at the camp entrance (screens 1-9 only) and hands the record forward to a paramedic.
